suppress.notes: False positive: 7.2.1.202505142326-r is the patched release for CVE-2025-4949 per Eclipse advisory. ODC matches the CPE range "up to 7.2.0" because it parses the OSGi version as 7.2.1 only.

False positive: Apache advisory for CVE-2026-54399 and CVE-2026-54428 applies to org.apache.httpcomponents.core5:httpcore5 (5.4.2 and earlier), not the legacy org.apache.httpcomponents:httpcore 4.4.x line. 4.4.16 is the latest 4.x release and is pulled transitively by hapi-fhir-server.

No OSS fix on Spring Boot 3.5 / Spring Framework 6.2.x: Spring advisories list 6.2.20 (enterprise-only) or 7.0.9 (OSS, requires Spring Boot 4). Latest 6.2.x on Maven Central is 6.2.19. CVE-2026-59283 (SpEL compiler) and CVE-2026-47886 (SpEL exponentiation) are not applicable: the application does not evaluate user-supplied SpEL. CVE-2026-47884 (XsltView) is not applicable: no view rendering or XsltView usage. CVE-2026-47885 (WebFlux multipart) and CVE-2026-47889 (Jetty WebFlux SameSite) are not applicable: the application uses Spring MVC with embedded Tomcat, not WebFlux or Jetty. CVE-2026-47888 (RSocket) is not applicable: RSocket is not used. CVE-2026-47883 (UrlHandlerFilter open redirect) and CVE-2026-47887 (UrlFileNameViewController open redirect) are not applicable: neither filter/controller is configured by this application. CVE-2026-59281 (XSS via Errors.getFieldErrors()/getFieldError()) is not applicable: this is a JSON REST API with no HTML view rendering or data-binding error views. CVE-2026-59280 (FreeMarker path traversal via SpringTemplateLoader) is not applicable: FreeMarker is not used. CVE-2026-59314 (Content-Disposition response splitting) is not applicable: the application never builds a Content-Disposition header from user-supplied input. Remaining CVEs require a Spring Boot 4 migration to resolve via OSS.

Not applicable: CVE-2026-47841 requires WebAuthn with userVerification=REQUIRED and a distributed session store; this application uses HTTP Basic auth only. CVE-2026-59270 requires the embedded UnboundIdContainer LDAP server; this application does not use it. CVE-2026-41707 (DPoP proof replay via DPoPProofJwtDecoderFactory cache eviction) is not applicable: the application does not use OAuth2 DPoP or DPoPProofJwtDecoderFactory. CVE-2026-47842 (null-IV AesBytesEncryptor via the 2-arg constructor) is not applicable: the application does not use AesBytesEncryptor. CVE-2026-59276 (non-constant-time String.equals() comparisons of security-sensitive values) is not applicable: the only credential check in this application is HTTP Basic auth verified through BCryptPasswordEncoder (see BasicAuthWebSecurityConfiguration), which does not use the affected comparison path; CSRF is disabled. No OSS fix on Spring Security 6.5.x anyway (6.5.12 is enterprise-only; 7.0.7+ requires Spring Boot 4).

Not applicable: CVE-2026-47852 (ONNX model cache substitution) requires a local multi-user host; the application runs as a single user in a container and does not use ONNX models. CVE-2026-47851 (PDF Document Reader recursion) is not applicable: the PDF reader module is not used. CVE-2026-59318 (tool-calling authorization bypass) affects DefaultToolCallingManager when per-request tool lists differ from the global resolver; the MCP server advertises a fixed tool set with no per-request variation, so the bypass path does not apply. CVE-2026-59294 (ResourceCacheService path traversal via URI fragment) is not applicable: the application does not use Spring AI's RAG/document-reader resource caching, only the fixed-tool MCP server starter. No OSS fix on Spring AI 1.1.x (1.1.9 is enterprise-only; 2.0.x requires Spring Boot 4).

False positive: NVD's CPE match for CVE-2026-54285 is cpe:2.3:a:opentelemetry:opentelemetry: *:*:*:*:*:node.js:*:* - the vulnerable W3CBaggagePropagator is in the opentelemetry-js (Node.js) package, not the unrelated Java opentelemetry-api artifact pulled in transitively via spring-ai-starter-mcp-server-webmvc.
